svg.aria-label: Singularity: a black hole whose accretion disk holds one particle for each of the 371 days from 2025-11-16 to 2026-11-21. Adil Akhtab Abir made 7 contributions on 2 of those days.

g.text: A world built on curiosity, code, and possibility.
7 CONTRIBUTIONS · 2 DAYS IN ORBIT · LONGEST STREAK 1 DAY
